memoryNodes.cue: Concrete and cement have different roles.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 混凝土与水泥的作用不同。

memoryNodes.cue: A building has been changed for a new use.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 建筑已改变为新的用途。

memoryNodes.cue: Lin gives a specific example of an entrance problem.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 林给出入口问题的具体例子。

data.situation:
The next table held a brick, a small piece of concrete and a sealed sample of cement. A caption explained that cement is one of the ingredients used to make concrete. Lin put the brick back on its tray, then turned to a photograph of the west wing before it opened. The warehouse had been converted into an exhibition space. Jo: The photograph makes the refurbishment easier to understand.
Architect: Yes. We refurbished the west wing first, so people could use it while work continued next door.
Lin: I would like to comment on the main entrance plan.
Architect: Please do. A concrete example helps: tell us which part of the plan you mean and how you would use it.
Lin: The door seems narrow in this drawing. Two people carrying boxes might struggle to pass each other. Your comments
Which part of the plan are you describing?
Give a concrete example of how you would use that space.
Please leave your note beside the old photograph.

readingBlocks.en: The next table held a brick, a small piece of concrete and a sealed sample of cement. A caption explained that cement is one of the ingredients used to make concrete. Lin put the brick back on its tray, then turned to a photograph of the west wing before it opened. The warehouse had been converted into an exhibition space.
readingBlocks.zh: 下一张桌上放着一块砖、一小块混凝土和密封的水泥样品。说明文字解释：水泥是制作混凝土的一种材料。林把砖放回托盘，转身看西翼开放前的照片。仓库已被改成展览空间。

readingBlocks.en:
Jo: The photograph makes the refurbishment easier to understand.
Architect: Yes. We refurbished the west wing first, so people could use it while work continued next door.
Lin: I would like to comment on the main entrance plan.
Architect: Please do. A concrete example helps: tell us which part of the plan you mean and how you would use it.
Lin: The door seems narrow in this drawing. Two people carrying boxes might struggle to pass each other.
readingBlocks.zh:
乔：照片让整修更容易理解。
建筑师：是的，我们先翻修西翼，让大家能使用，旁边的工程再继续。
林：我想对主入口计划提点意见。
建筑师：请说。具体例子有帮助：说明你指计划的哪一部分，以及会怎样使用。
林：图上的门似乎窄了点，两个人搬箱子可能不易错身。

glossary.zh: 由水泥等材料混合制成的建筑材料；混凝土
glossary.note: 不可数材料名词；a piece of concrete。
glossary.example: The table holds a small piece of concrete.

externalEvidence.definition: a strong hard building material composed of sand and gravel and cement and water

glossary.zh: 可与其他材料混合并硬化的水泥
glossary.note: 不可数材料名词；与成品混凝土concrete区分。
glossary.example: Cement is an ingredient used to make concrete.
glossary.exampleZh: 水泥是制作混凝土的一种材料。

externalEvidence.definition: a building material that is a powder made of a mixture of calcined limestone and clay; used with water and sand or gravel to make concrete and mortar

externalEvidence.label: Oxford Learner’s Dictionaries
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: Cement is distinct from the concrete mixture; original source wording remains unchanged.

glossary.zh: 被改变用途，成为另一种事物
glossary.note: be converted into + 新用途或新形态。
glossary.example: The warehouse has been converted into an exhibition space.

glossary.zh: 整修并改善建筑等的状态
glossary.example: They refurbished the west wing first.

externalEvidence.label: Oxford Learner’s Dictionaries
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: The selected noun denotes an act/process; WordNet candidate describes a state and is not forced to match.

glossary.zh: 具体明确的，而非抽象笼统的
glossary.note: concrete example/details；这里为形容词，与建筑材料名词分开。
glossary.example: Lin gives a concrete example of an entrance problem.
glossary.exampleZh: 林给出入口问题的具体例子。

externalEvidence.label: Oxford Learner’s Dictionaries
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: Specific, fact-based example/details; separate from the building material.
